settings.heading: Our story
settings.text:
The Christmas Sweet Shop is an online shop for Christmas trees, decorations, greenery and lighting, with collections for the other seasons of the year.

We want decorating to be the easy part of December. That means clear product pages, honest photographs and straight answers when you ask a question.

settings.heading: How we choose what to sell
settings.text: Before a product goes on the site we ask three things. Will it go up without a struggle? Will it pack away and come back out looking the same next year? Does the description say exactly what arrives in the box?
